name: Azriel
overview: Azriel was a male descendant of the tribe of Naphtali, known specifically as the father of Jeremoth. His mention in Scripture is concise, focusing on his genealogical role without additional narrative detail. There are no further notes expanding on his life or character.
namesAndTitles: The name Azriel means 'G-d is my help,' reflecting a theologically rich Hebrew meaning that underscores reliance on divine assistance. This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God but carries a significant spiritual connotation.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Azriel as the father of Jeremoth and explicitly identifies him as a descendant of Naphtali. Beyond these relationships, no other family connections are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Azriel's significance lies chiefly in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Naphtali, serving as a link in the lineage that includes Jeremoth. His mention in 1 Chronicles 27:19 situates him within the organizational structure of Israel's tribal leadership during the period chronicled. Though brief, this record contributes to the biblical emphasis on heritage and tribal identity under God's providence.
